policy: Only a primary venue source may generate a proposed event. GitHub PR review is required; no direct publication.

sources.name: Black Water
sources.reason: First priority. Official Black Water public iCalendar feed is active; preserve date-only timestamps and report missing showtimes for review.

sources.name: High Water Mark
sources.reason: Second priority. Direct venue host returned HTTP 403 to GitHub; do not bypass access controls. Use the verified Soundcontrol primary-promoter feed when possible and stage uncertain times for review.
sources.address: 6800 NE Martin Luther King Jr Blvd, Portland, OR 97211

sources.name: Soundcontrol PDX
sources.reason: Primary multi-venue promoter supports High Water Mark and other preferred locations. Preserve original venue per bill; do not infer showtime from a date-only flyer.
sources.enabledReason: Primary event HTML structure verified by GitHub Actions live probes; review-only candidate PRs, not publication.

sources.name: Twilight Cafe and Bar

sources.name: Star Theater

sources.name: Roseland Theater

sources.name: Wonder Ballroom
sources.reason: Official Wonder pages display showtimes with year in event-specific metadata. Require independently matching visible day/date/weekday; exclude moved, postponed, inconsistent or year-unknown entries. All records require editorial PR review.
sources.enabledReason: Read-only GitHub runner probe 39726379458 found 36 official first-party event links, verified ten of twelve detailed shows and held two missing year evidence. Daily review-only candidate ingestion.

sources.name: Hawthorne Theatre

sources.enabledReason: Live GitHub Actions runner probe verified official source links, dates, showtimes and venues on 2026-10-21: https://github.com/julegan/shows/actions/runs/39723996416. Review-only event proposals.

sources.name: High Limit Room
sources.reason: Official High Limit Room site embeds Afton Tickets' checkout widget on /shows/. No accessible first-party static event feed or documented authorized API has been established. Seek venue-provided calendar/ICS export or official ticket-provider integration; do not infer dates from resale sites or reuse public widget keys as API credentials.

sources.enabledReason: Live GitHub Actions original venue source probe 39733648322: 56 first-party detail records inspected, 55 valid dated Crystal events, one venue move/room conflict held. Review-only import.
